findings.issue: Stated target is a later Layer 9 stage than the material supports. README.md orders Layer 9: split reductive group schemes over `ℤ` (l.245) → pinnings (l.247) → the Chevalley–Demazure construction (l.251) → base change along `ℤ → k` with pinning compatibility (l.253) → root subgroup maps `x_α : 𝔾_a → G` (l.255). The PR cites the last two, but neither the group scheme nor a pinning exists on `main`, and the diff contains no scheme, no `𝔾_a`, and no pinning: `baseChangeKostantExpHom` is `Multiplicative R →* (R ⊗[ℤ] M ≃ₗ[R] R ⊗[ℤ] M)`, with no naturality in `R` — the PR description itself concedes "still needs naturality of these actions in the value ring, their assembly into scheme morphisms". Without naturality this is not a `𝔾_a`-action and cannot be the cited base-change or root-subgroup-map bullet.

findings.issue: Advancement: this is the eighth file in the Kostant lane citing Layer 9 (Form, Comultiplication, HopfAlgebra, Antipode, Orbit, Exponential, Sl2/KostantSpan, ~2100 lines with this PR), while nothing named in the construction bullet has landed — no Chevalley basis, no admissible lattice, no group-valued object. `grep -r 'ChevalleyBasis|admissibleLattice' TauCeti/` returns nothing, and Orbit.lean states the lattice property is still unproved pending integral PBW, so every hypothesis-parameterised operator here still has no instantiation at the level the construction needs.

summary: Single topic, and the divided-power-over-any-ring content is a genuine ingredient of the Layer 9 Chevalley–Demazure construction bullet, but the PR cites the two *later* Layer 9 bullets (base change with pinning compatibility; root subgroup maps `x_α : 𝔾_a → G`) whose prerequisite stages — split reductive group schemes over `ℤ`, pinnings, the construction itself — are absent from `main` and from this diff. Re-state the claim against the stage this material actually feeds.
